artist.bio:
There are more bands called ADHD:

1.)  adHD is an indie prog rock trio from Seattle, WA, USA. Their "Distraction EP" is available on iTunes, Zune, etc. Their web page is http://adhdrocks.us 

2.)ADHD is a dutch rap crew concisting out of :Dicecream(MC), Brainpower(MC), Man!ak(MC/producer) and DJ TLM (producer). In 2004 they released their first and probably last album “Aanbevolen Dagelijkse Hoeveelheid Dopeness”

3.)ADHD is a rock band based out of Washington, DC. Their first ep, "Acts Up" was released in the Spring of 2004. The follow-up self-titled release found regular radio airplay and earned the band a spot in the top 5 of mtvU's "Best Music on Campus" in 2005. The band is currently recording a full length album, and is unsigned.

4.)ADHD is a polish punk rock band from Maniowy.

5.) ADHD is another polish band, formed by previous members of tapta, chico and hariasen. 

members;

qbenz-voc(chico, tapta, generation gap, jcp)
rumak-guitar(tapta, generation gap)
michael-drums(tapta, generation gap, hard work)
michny-bass(hariasen)
vazon-guitar(chico, jcp, genaration gap)

more info about this ADHD band you can find on www.myspace.com/silesifornia

6.) AdHd is a Jazz band from Iceland.
AdHd (formerly known as AdHd800...) was originally put together to perform at a blues festival in the beautiful town of Hofn in Iceland. The goal was to play a few standards and some newly written material, written by the bands members. Their collaboration was a huge success and for the past year they have been working on new material that ended up on their debut album, adhd. The album contains 7 new songs, that are melodic and melancholic at times.

The album was recorded in Oskars living room in August 2009 and released in december same year. The record got good reviews, 4 1/2 out of 5 in Morgunbladid.

ADHD are: Oskar Gudjonsson: Saxophones, Omar Gudjonsson: Guitars, bass, David Thor Jonsson: Hammond, rhodes, bass etc., Magnus Trygvason Eliassen: Drums
